"""Verify/adopt268 completed calls and freeze an explicit disk-guard continuation."""
import ast
import json
import shutil
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import psutil
import torch
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live
from review_harmonic_phase_trial import equal_tree
from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V163-harmonic-phase-v1'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);original=read(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json')
assert original['status']=='failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry'
assert original['completed']['review']['returncode']==1 and original['completed']['checkpoint-validation']['returncode']==0
assert not live(original['owner']) and not live(original['child_owner'])
training=read(root/'status-v1.json');assert not live(training['owner'])
assert read(root/'review-checkpoint-readiness-v1.json')['finite_Adam_states_at1000']==93
point=root/'review-v1/anchor-control-raw-step1000'
forward=point/'forward-events-v1.jsonl';observation=point/'observations-v1.jsonl'
events=[json.loads(s) for s in forward.read_text().splitlines()]
rows=[json.loads(s) for s in observation.read_text().splitlines()]
assert len(events)==len(rows)==268
assert not (point/'collection-v1.json').exists() and not (root/'review-result-v1.json').exists()
cases=read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')['observations']
prior_binding=plan['control_collections']['anchor-control-raw-step1000'];assert ref(prior_binding['path'])==prior_binding
prior=read(prior_binding['path']);oldrows={r['id']:r for r in prior['observations']}
export=point/'module.pt';saved=torch.load(export,map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
result=read(root/'train-result-v1.json');state=torch.load(result['checkpoint']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
assert saved['paired_training_checkpoint']==result['checkpoint']
assert saved['arm']=='anchor-control' and saved['endpoint']=='raw'
assert equal_tree(saved['state_dict'],state['models']['anchor-control'])
old_export=torch.load(prior['export']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
assert equal_tree(saved['state_dict'],old_export['state_dict'])
for index,(event,row,case) in enumerate(zip(events,rows,cases[:268],strict=True)):
    assert event=={'index':index,'id':case['id'],'returned_forwards':index+1}
    assert row['id']==case['id'] and row['parent']==case['parent']
    assert row['module_forwards']==1 and row['archive_replayed_bit_exact']
    assert row['prediction']==oldrows[case['id']]['prediction'] and ref(row['prediction']['path'])==row['prediction']
    assert row['values']==fingerprint(np.load(row['prediction']['path']))
    assert ref(case['arrays']['path'])==case['arrays'] and ref(case['parent']['path'])==case['parent']
    a=dict(np.load(case['arrays']['path']))
    assert row['inputs']=={key:fingerprint(a[key]) for key in ['packed','variance','colors','wb']}
    assert all(np.isfinite(row[k]) for k in ['support_mean','coefficient_correction_RMS','spatial_correction_RMS_DN16'])
adoption=root/'review-adoption-v2.json';assert not adoption.exists()
save(adoption,{'status':'pass268-complete-exact-control-observations-adopted-no-repeat',
    'recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'original_status':ref(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json'),
    'original_queue_log':ref(root/'queue-controller-v1.log'),'original_review_log':ref(root/'postprocess-review-v1.log'),
    'original_postprocess_plan':ref(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json'),'original_export':ref(export),
    'original_forward_journal':ref(forward),'original_observation_journal':ref(observation),
    'adopted_endpoint':'anchor-control-raw-step1000','adopted_head_calls':268,'adopted_prediction_arrays':0,
    'original_collection':prior_binding,'new_head_calls_remaining':3020,
    'actual_original_review_and_queue_terminal':True,'scientific_stage_failures':1,'full_training_restarts':0,
    'new_CPU_forward_calls':0,'new_CUDA_forward_calls':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
    'disk_guard_failure':'Combined predicate local>60GiB AND external>148GiB failed;log has no per-disk snapshot,so failing disk is unproven.',
    'observed_free_GiB':{'local':shutil.disk_usage(repo).free/2**30,'external':shutil.disk_usage('/mnt/external').free/2**30},
    'continuation_reserve_GiB':{'local':58,'external':148,'projection_margin':.5,'bounded_remaining_local_artifacts':.25},
    'scope':'Original returned events and complete observation journals agree for all268 calls;source/input/parent/output fingerprints and exact trained control weights verified. No completed call repeated. Statistical design,weights,model arithmetic,data,822 cases,display and planned5412 scientific root calls stay unchanged. Explicit continuation after authoritative failure,not a timeout retry.',
    'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
post=root/'postprocess-v2/scripts';post.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
for p in (root/'postprocess-v1/scripts').glob('*.py'):shutil.copyfile(p,post/p.name)
p=post/'review_harmonic_phase_trial.py';s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('    assert not (root / "review.claim").exists()\n    (root / "review.claim").open("x").close()',
    '    adoption=read(root/"review-adoption-v2.json")\n    assert adoption["adopted_head_calls"]==268\n    (root/"review-continuation-v2.claim").open("x").close()')
s=s.replace('    total = controls_exact = saved_predictions = 0', '    total = controls_exact = saved_predictions = 0\n    new_calls=0')
s=s.replace('            point = Path(plan["quality_output_roots"][label]) / label',
    '            point = Path(plan["quality_output_roots"][label]).parent / "review-v2" / label')
s=s.replace('            count = [0]', '''            inherited=label==adoption['adopted_endpoint']
            adopted_rows=[];adopted_forward=[]
            if inherited:
                for key in ['original_forward_journal','original_observation_journal','original_export']:
                    assert ref(adoption[key]['path'])==adoption[key]
                adopted_rows=[json.loads(v) for v in Path(adoption['original_observation_journal']['path']).read_text().splitlines()]
                adopted_forward=[json.loads(v) for v in Path(adoption['original_forward_journal']['path']).read_text().splitlines()]
                assert len(adopted_rows)==len(adopted_forward)==268
            count = [len(adopted_rows)]''')
s=s.replace('            rows = []', '            rows = list(adopted_rows)')
needle='            for index, case in enumerate(design["observations"]):'
assert needle in s;s=s.replace(needle,'''            if inherited:
                observation_stream.write(Path(adoption['original_observation_journal']['path']).read_text());observation_stream.flush()
                forward_stream.write(Path(adoption['original_forward_journal']['path']).read_text());forward_stream.flush()
                total+=268;controls_exact+=268
            for index, case in enumerate(design["observations"]):
                if index<len(adopted_rows):
                    assert case['id']==adopted_rows[index]['id']
                    continue''')
s=s.replace('shutil.disk_usage(root).free > 60 * 2**30','shutil.disk_usage(root).free > 58 * 2**30')
s=s.replace('                value = output.cpu().numpy()', '                new_calls+=1\n                value = output.cpu().numpy()')
s=s.replace('                    "component_forwards": count[0],', '                    "component_forwards": count[0],\n                    "adopted_prior_returned_forwards":len(adopted_rows),\n                    "new_component_forwards":count[0]-len(adopted_rows),\n                    "adoption":ref(root/"review-adoption-v2.json") if inherited else None,')
s=s.replace('    assert total == 3288 and controls_exact == saved_predictions == 1644',
    '    assert total == 3288 and controls_exact == saved_predictions == 1644 and new_calls==3020')
s=s.replace('            "component_forwards": total,', '            "component_forwards": total,\n            "adopted_prior_returned_forwards":268,"continuation_new_component_forwards":new_calls,\n            "adoption":ref(root/"review-adoption-v2.json"),"scientific_stage_failures":1,"full_training_restarts":0,')
ast.parse(s);p.write_text(s)
p=post/'diagnose_harmonic_phase_trial.py';s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('import os\n','import os\nimport shutil\n')
s=s.replace('classes, resource_check, runtime','classes, runtime')
at=s.index('def main(root):')
s=s[:at]+'''def resource_check(root):
    assert psutil.virtual_memory().available>32*2**30
    assert shutil.disk_usage(root).free>58*2**30
    assert shutil.disk_usage('/mnt/external').free>148*2**30


'''+s[at:]
ast.parse(s);p.write_text(s)
save(root/'review-continuation-sources-v2.json',{'adoption':ref(adoption),
    'frozen_files':{str(p):ref(p)['sha256'] for p in post.glob('*.py')},
    'same_statistical_design':ref(root/'quality-design-v1.json'),'new_root_calls_remaining':3020,
    'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
print('Verified/adopted268 original calls;frozen10 continuation sources;3020 remaining calls;zero repeated/new forwards')
